features: Reel Import — Share an Instagram Reel to Echo Music: it identifies the song and asks you to confirm the match, then adds it to a playlist you choose — with an optional default playlist so future reels are added in one tap.
bug_fixes: Reel Import is now metadata-first: the reel's caption and Instagram audio track fields are searched on YouTube Music within seconds, before any audio download is attempted.
Caption song hints (song:/music:/audio: markers, ♪ lyric fragments, quoted song names) are mined for far better matches; hashtag/emoji/noise-prefix cleanup improved.
The import flow never dead-ends anymore — a manual song search is built into the candidate picker, including when automatic identification fails.
yt-dlp audio extraction hardened with a browser user-agent and relaxed TLS checks for reels that blocked anonymous downloads.
